mechanism: Modafinil inhibits CYP2C9, which metabolizes naproxen, potentially increasing naproxen exposure and NSAID-related adverse effects; naproxen may increase modafinil levels through similar CYP pathways.
action: Monitor for naproxen toxicity signs (GI bleeding, renal dysfunction); consider alternative analgesic or dose adjustment of naproxen if used concurrently.
